en.name: Rabbit, whole and fresh
en.summary: A fresh whole rabbit is very lean white meat with almost no fat cover, which is why it dries out easily and why it keeps a short time chilled. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below it lasts 2 days; frozen at −18 °C (0 °F) it keeps 9 months.
en.pantry: Fresh rabbit has no room-temperature storage. It is raw meat, so the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) and the two-hour rule apply — one hour if the day is above 32 °C (90 °F). Rabbit is often bought from a farm gate or a market stall rather than a chilled cabinet, so take a cool bag: the journey home is where most of its short fridge life gets spent.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on a tray on the bottom shelf, and cook it within 2 days. That is a genuinely short window, shorter than chicken, so plan the meal around the purchase rather than the other way round. Store it below anything ready to eat, use a separate board and knife, wash your hands after handling it, and cook it right through. If you are marinating it, do so in the fridge in a covered dish, and do not count the marinating time as extra storage.
en.freezer: Rabbit keeps 9 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality, a long window that reflects how little fat there is to go rancid. Joint it before freezing — saddle, legs and forelegs cook at different speeds anyway — and wrap each piece tightly before bagging, because a lean meat with no fat cover suffers badly from freezer burn. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality. Label with the date.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight on a tray, or in a sealed bag under cold running water and cook straight away. Never on the counter. Do not refreeze rabbit that has fully thawed at room temperature — cook it, then freeze the cooked dish if you must.
spoilage: A sour or distinctly gamey-off smell rather than a faintly sweet, clean one.
A sticky or slimy film on the surface of the carcass.
Flesh gone dull grey or greenish, especially around the belly flaps.
Liquid in the pack gone cloudy or ropy.
tips: Take a cool bag to the market; this meat has no spare days to lose.
Joint it the day you buy it and freeze what you will not cook.
Save the liver and kidneys separately and use them first.
Bard or brine it before roasting — lean rabbit dries out faster than it spoils.

faq.q: How long does fresh rabbit keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on a tray on the bottom shelf.
Yes, 9 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Joint it first and wrap each piece tightly against freezer burn.

faq.q: How do you thaw rabbit safely?
faq.a: Overnight in the fridge on a tray, or in a sealed bag under cold running water followed by immediate cooking. Never on the counter.

zh.name: 全兔（生鮮）
zh.summary: 生鮮全兔是非常瘦的白肉，幾乎沒有皮下脂肪，所以容易乾柴，冷藏期也短。放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天；−18 °C 冷凍則可放 9 個月。
zh.pantry: 生鮮兔肉沒有常溫保存。它是生肉，所以 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶與 2 小時原則都適用，氣溫超過 32 °C 時縮為 1 小時。兔肉常常是在農場或市場攤位買的，不是從冷藏櫃拿的，所以請帶保冷袋：它本來就很短的冷藏壽命，大半是耗在回家的路上。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下、最下層墊托盤，2 天內烹調。這個期限是真的短，比雞肉還短，所以請先決定哪天煮再去買，而不是反過來。位置放在所有即食食品下方，砧板和刀要分開，處理後洗手，並且要煮透。要醃的話請在冰箱裡加蓋醃，而且醃的時間算在保存期內，不是額外加送的。
zh.freezer: 兔肉在 −18 °C 下品質可維持 9 個月，這個期限之所以長，正是因為它沒什麼會走油耗的脂肪。冷凍前先分切——背脊、後腿和前腿本來熟成速度就不同——每塊包緊再裝袋，因為沒有脂肪保護的瘦肉特別怕凍傷。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。記得標日期。
zh.thawing: 墊托盤冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋用冷水沖、沖完立刻下鍋。不要放室溫退冰。已在室溫下完全退冰的兔肉不要再冷凍——先煮熟，真要保存就冷凍煮好的菜。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有明顯的腐敗腥味，而不是淡淡的清甜味。
體表摸起來黏手、有一層滑膜。
肉色轉暗灰或帶綠，尤其是腹脅薄肉的部位。
包裝裡的血水變混濁或牽絲。
tips: 去市場記得帶保冷袋；這種肉沒有多餘的天數可以浪費。
買回來當天就分切，不煮的部分直接冷凍。
肝和腰子另外收好，而且要最先用掉。
烤之前包油或泡鹽水——瘦兔肉變乾柴，比變質還快。

faq.q: 生鮮兔肉冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下、墊托盤放最下層，2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 9 個月品質最好。先分切、每塊包緊，才不會凍傷。
墊托盤冷藏隔夜，或密封裝袋用冷水沖、沖完立刻烹調。不要放室溫。
